connector.name: Openrouter Admin
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for OpenRouter management API: credits, key CRUD, activity drill-down, dashboard.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package openrouter-admin-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oviron account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: OPENROUTER_PROVISIONING_KEY
env.description: OpenRouter Provisioning API key — create at https://openrouter.ai/settings/provisioning. Distinct from inference keys: it can manage your account but cannot make completion calls.

env.name: OPENROUTER_ADMIN_ALLOW_WRITE
env.description: Set to '1' to enable destructive write tools (or_key_create, or_key_update, or_key_delete). Disabled by default — read-only tools (or_overview, or_credits, or_keys_list, or_key_get, or_activity, or_current_key) are always available.
